claims.text: Alfonso Cuarón wrote, photographed and directed Roma (2018).
Guillermo del Toro and Alejandro G. Iñárritu did not direct Roma, and Luis Buñuel died in 1983.
Cuarón shot Roma in black and white, acting as his own cinematographer.
Cuarón directed Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004) and Gravity (2013).
